bagPolicy.summary: Only bags smaller than 12 × 12 inches may enter; they do not need to be clear but are searched. Backpacks are prohibited and oversize bags cannot be held at will call.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theatre does not operate public parking. Its FAQ lists nearby surface lots at Lawrence and Broadway, Lawrence and Winthrop, and Truman College on Wilson.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The operator’s Riviera FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue is cashless and accepts debit and credit cards; outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Call the theatre at 773-275-6800 to arrange ADA accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Riviera Theatre does not allow re-entry.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Use the AXS app to display your mobile ticket; paper tickets are not required. The Riviera box office sells any remaining tickets on show nights and opens when doors open.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open 90 minutes before showtime, but the exact time is posted on each event page. Small bags are searched at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
